PART I

ITEMS 1 AND 2. BUSINESS AND PROPERTIES

Bolt Freight Inc. operates 40 terminals. We use machine learning models to forecast freight volumes at 40 terminals. A discussion of liquidity appears later in this report.

Item 7 of this report discusses our liquidity and capital resources.

We own most of our trucks and lease the remainder from third parties under operating leases that expire at various dates.

ITEM 1A.RISK FACTORS

Competitors may use AI to lower their costs. If our AI models contain errors, our business could be adversely affected.

ITEM 6.[RESERVED]

Item 7. Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations. Revenue increased 6% compared with the prior year, and our AI-powered routing engine reduced fuel consumption by 7%, which improved operating margins across all regions in which we operate.
